    Bandit Simulator TD

    PC (Microsoft Windows) • 2026

    Should you play it?

    This is a "Tower Defense + Base Building" game where you establish a bandit stronghold from scratch. With "Tower defense" at its core, you can ambush travelers, develop characters through profession and equipment systems, and expand your stronghold by researching, forging, and constructing!

    What works

    • Deep and complex incremental mechanics
    • Mix of idle, tower defense, and rpg elements
    • Active developer support and updates
    • Historical and fantasy character integration
    • Engaging long-term progression

    Things to keep in mind

    • Excessive grinding and tedious manual tasks
    • Lack of automation and presets
    • Poor ui and cumbersome management
    • Slow progression and low drop rates
    • No multiplayer or social features
